actions: jq -c '.user_list // [] | map(select(. != null) | tostring | ascii_downcase) | unique' "$TMPDIR/incident_B.json"
jq -s 'if length == 1 and (.[0] | type) == "array" then .[0] elif length == 1 and (.[0] | type) == "object" then [.[0]] else . end' "$EVENTS_FILE"
jq --argjson hosts "$hosts" --arg start "$window_start" --arg end "$window_end" 'map(select(incident host and time window))' "$TMPDIR/all_events.json"
jq 'if type == "array" then . elif .tickets? then .tickets elif .change_tickets? then .change_tickets else [] end' "$CHANGE_TICKETS"
jq --slurpfile iocs "$TMPDIR/ioc_objects.jsonl" 'map(select(.dst_ip != null)) | map(match destination IP against IOC values)' "$TMPDIR/events_normalized.json"
jq -c 'if type == "array" then . elif .assets? then .assets else [] end' "$ASSETS_FILE"
ticket_match_outcome: ticket_found=true host=match window=match owner=mismatch scope=mismatch verdict=TP

jq --arg incident_id "$incident_id" --arg started "$investigation_start" --arg ended "$investigation_end" --arg hypothesis "$hypothesis" --arg confidence "$confidence" --arg ambiguity "$ambiguity_notes" --argjson event_refs "$event_refs" --argjson techniques "$techniques" --argjson actions "$actions" --argjson ioc_matches "$ioc_matches" --arg ticket_outcome "$ticket_outcome_narrative" ...
hypothesis: Outbound communication from the affected host matched a supplied IOC while the associated change activity failed at least one approval check, consistent with unauthorized command-and-control or external communication.
